The logs cannot answer either part of your question. They contain no cost data and no record of customer-facing downtime, so I can only report what the BGL data shows for June 2005.

## Observed Facts

- **Data Scope:** Dataset BGL, 2005-06-01 to 2005-06-30 (end exclusive 2005-07-01), no component or level filter unless noted. The BGL corpus spans 2005-06-03 15:42:50 to 2006-01-04 08:00:05 [E1].
- **Volume:** 1,240,932 Log Entries in June 2005 [E2]. By level: INFO 685,088; FATAL 548,475; WARNING 2,568; SEVERE 2,434; ERROR 2,351; Kill 15; FAILURE 1 [E3].
- **Daily shape:** Entry counts are uneven, with peaks on 2005-06-05 (101,380), 2005-06-11 (152,669), and 2005-06-14 (381,561), and low days such as 2005-06-10 (1,462) [E2].
- **FATAL by Component:** Of the 548,475 FATAL Log Entries, KERNEL has 535,054, APP has 13,409, and LINKCARD has 12 [E4].
- **No "outage" label:** The June data has no field or message that marks an outage window, so I can't tell from the logs which period, if any, was an outage [E2, E3].

## Hypotheses

- The KERNEL FATAL concentration [E4] is the strongest signal for prioritisation. It is a frequency measure of Log Entries in one Component, not evidence of an incident or of its severity.
- The June 14 spike [E2] may line up with whatever event prompted your question, but the logs alone don't confirm that.

## Unknowns

- **Cost:** The logs contain no financial data. Any cost figure cannot be derived from them.
- **Customer downtime hours:** The logs don't record customer sessions, availability, or service state, so downtime hours cannot be measured. Log Entry timestamps show activity, not whether users were affected.
- **Whether June 2005 was an outage:** Nothing in the data establishes this.
- **Incident boundaries:** Log Entries are not incidents, and I can't group them into incidents from this data.

## Next Step

For cost and downtime, check the finance records and the service-availability or ticketing systems for June 2005. If you can share the start and end times of the outage you have in mind, I can pull the Log Entry counts and Component breakdown for that exact window to compare with the rest of June.
